title: Cost Projections for Utility-Scale Battery Storage: 2025 Update

values.quote: Cost Projections for Utility-Scale Battery Storage: 2025 Update
June 2025
The 2024 starting point of $334/kWh is derived from the bottom-up cost model described in Section 2.2.
All cost values were converted to 2024$ using the consumer pricing index.
The FOM value selected is 4% of the $/kW capacity cost for a 4-hour battery.

values.blank_context: fixed O&M ___% of capex a year
values.quote: The FOM value selected is 4% of the $/kW capacity cost for a 4-hour battery.
The lifetime we selected is 15 years, which is on the lower end of published values.
The round-trip efficiency is chosen to be 85%, which is well aligned with published values.

unsupported_wording: Minor: source says FOM is 4% 'of the $/kW capacity cost', not 'of capex'; 'a year' is not in the quoted sentence (read via summarizing fetch, so verify on p. 11). Report number in claim is garbled ('TP-___A4___-___'); printed form is NREL/TP-6A40-93281.
note: Authors Wesley Cole, Vignesh Ramasamy, Merve Turan confirmed on cover. $334/kWh is the 2024 starting point (2024$). Page numbers as reported by fetch tool.
